details:
VPM resolver version: 0.1.29

SDK version: 3.5.2

Description:

The package resolver can DELETE entire package repos if first added (from online) via the VCC, then removed and readded from disk using the Unity package manager.

This seems to be related to the packages presence in vpm-manifest.json despite being removed and added again via the Unity package manager. If the package is instead removed using the VCC the issue does not occur.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Clone a github repository of an interesting package that is also available on the Creator Companion to somewhere away from the project folder. (and ensure that package is installable via the VCC) (I have used d4rkAvatarOptimizer in my case)

2. Create a new empty project using the Creator Companion.

3. Add the target package via the Creator Companion and then open the project.

4. Open the Unity package manager via Window -> Package Manager

5. Remove the package added via the VCC, then select '+' -> 'Add Package from disk' and choose the package.json from the repository cloned earlier.

6. Allow Unity to recompile everything and then close the project.

7. When opening the project again, a dialog is presented "This project requires some VRChat Packages which are not in the project yet.\n\nPress OK to download and install them."

7a. Upon pressing OK, the resolver just straight up deletes the cloned repository except for a few loose files in the .git folder. (These files inside .git are marked read-only and can't be deleted without -Force) The SDK presents several errors that I can't screenshot because I'm tired and don't want to do it again.

7b. If instead "Show Me What's Missing" is pressed (or the popup is closed), the editor displays the intended dialog for a fraction of a second before it disappears. (On my larger project it just hangs the editor forever)

I would have lost data to this if I didn't have the files I needed open in VS code so I could copy-paste them when I re-cloned the repository. (it shows them deleted but keeps the contents in memory god bless)

I have attached a picture of my friend's cat as a bribe.
title: SDK can DELETE entire package folders outside of the project
